artifacts.purpose: Exact list of the 11 held-out USGS gauges and 60 held-out Caravan basins that the served models never saw.
Per-gauge Q90/Q99 thresholds, static catchment facts and gauge names used at inference for the 55 training gauges.
Forecast model for rivers under 10,000 sq mi (trained on 55 USGS gauges + 479 Caravan basins, tuned). Held-out version: trained without the 11 test gauges and 60 test basins.
Forecast model for rivers of 10,000 sq mi or more (trained on the 55 USGS gauges). Held-out version: trained without the 11 test gauges.
